# Problems and hints are written in Claude Code, not generated by the app

The app never calls the Claude API. New Problems, whether proposed by Claude or added from LeetCode, are written as files in the Problem Bank during Claude Code sessions: statement, stub, tests and three pre-written Hints. Claude reads the history database to make its proposals history-aware. This avoids managing API keys and per-request costs, keeps the app offline, and means each Hint level is the same fixed amount of help every time, so a recorded hint count is comparable across Problems. That is why the app has no "add problem" form and no live hint chat.

## Considered Options

- **In-app Claude API** for proposals and live hints: hints could respond to the learner's actual code, but it needs a key, costs money, and makes the recorded hint usage inconsistent. It may come back later as an optional setting.
